hooks.command: CMD=$(python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print(d.get('tool_input',d).get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null || true); case "$CMD" in *lib/*) case "$CMD" in *grep*|*rg\ *|*find\ *|*fd\ *) [ -f graphify-out/graph.json ] && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"graphify indexes lib/ well (62k nodes): `graphify query`/`affected` may beat this grep. It does NOT index test/ (22 nodes) or replace doc authority. Check graph freshness vs HEAD first."}}' || true ;; esac ;; esac

HIT=$(python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);t=d.get('tool_input',d);s=(str(t.get('file_path') or '')+' '+str(t.get('pattern') or '')+' '+str(t.get('path') or '')).replace(chr(92),'/');exts=('.dart','.py','.js','.ts','.tsx','.go','.rs','.java','.kt','.swift');sys.stdout.write('1' if 'lib/' in s and 'graphify-out/' not in s and any(e in s for e in exts) else '')" 2>/dev/null || true); if [ "$HIT" = 1 ] && [ -f graphify-out/graph.json ]; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"lib/ is graphify-indexed: `graphify query \"<q>\"` / `explain` / `affected` may be cheaper than reading this file. Verify graph freshness vs HEAD; test/ and docs authority are not covered."}}'; fi || true
